# Isochron v1 test vectors - generated by `iso_test vectors` (pow/isomain.inc).
# Line-oriented: every data line is `tag key=value ...`; '#' lines are comments.
# u64 fields are lowercase hex, zero-padded to 16 digits, no 0x prefix.
# count/size/index fields (count=, size=, codesize=, i=, op=) are decimal.
# role_offs/per_block are comma-separated decimal: the two frozen tables,
# dumped so a port can assert its own copies against the oracle's and so the
# opcodes section below is reconstructable from this file alone.
#
# padck is a TEST ARTIFACT, not consensus: h = 0; for each 64-bit
# little-endian word w of the scratchpad, in address order:
#   h = (h XOR w) * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15   (mod 2^64)
# padck = h. XOR-fold plus a multiply per word so word order matters.
